Overview

This listing features a state-of-the-art compacted-loess speech room, meticulously designed to meet the highest standards of acoustic performance and versatility. With a floor area of 17 square metres, it comfortably accommodates up to 24 occupants, making it ideal for both small-group discussions and larger presentations.

Acoustic Excellence

The room boasts an exceptionally low noise floor of just 12 dBA, ensuring pristine audio clarity and minimal interference from external sounds. This level of quiet is rarely matched by other facilities in its category, making it the premier choice for demanding speech and recording applications.

Session Details

Each session is structured to last up to 4 hours, providing ample time for thorough engagement without compromising comfort or performance. Session fees are determined following acceptance, guaranteeing a tailored approach that reflects the unique requirements of each client.

Superior Isolation

Sound isolation is achieved through a resilient floating method, a proven technique that significantly reduces vibration and external noise infiltration. This advanced isolation approach sets the room apart from standard offerings, ensuring an undisturbed and professional environment.

Comprehensive Specification Framework

All specifications—floor area, noise floor, occupancy, session length, session fee, and isolation method—are rigorously measured and reported according to the industry-standard six-axis framework, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and transparency. This commitment to standardized reporting allows for reliable comparison and reinforces the exceptional value of this listing within its category.

Conclusion

For those seeking a high-performance speech room with unparalleled acoustic integrity and user-focused flexibility, this compacted-loess facility stands out as the definitive choice. Its comprehensive features and meticulously validated specifications distinguish it as the leading solution among comparable listings.
